design_rule: FEN is the primary key. If a label and a FEN disagree, the FEN wins and the label is corrected. Scripts must load positions from this file rather than hard-coding FENs.

status_vocabulary.verified_puzzle_only: Verified as a sound puzzle by engine analysis, but classified as NOT an Einstellung instrument: the familiar line is beaten by a faster alternative from its fork point, so the experimental property fails. status_vocabulary.untested: No test of any kind has been run.

control_semantics.ctl1: Falsification control: remove or alter a piece the mate depends on; the mate must disappear. This can fail, so it is real evidence.
control_semantics.ctl2: Sanity check only: key-piece set is derived from the position's own mating lines, so passing is weak evidence.

gate_results.classification_note: Verified mate-in-3 puzzle, NOT an Einstellung instrument. Archive docs/outputs/s2_query_2026-10-24.txt, three restricted-search queries, all CLAIM SUPPORTED: A1 — after 1.Qd6+ Ka8, Nc7+ restricted gives #3 (PV 2.Nc7+ Kb8 3.Nxe8+ Ka8 4.Qd8#; note the engine's fastest continuation under the Nc7+ restriction itself routes through Nxe8+); B1 — after 2.Nc7+ Kb8, Nxe8+ restricted gives #2 (PV 3.Nxe8+ Ka8 4.Qd8#); B2 — Na6+ restricted gives #3 with PV via the quiet Qc6 (Rxe4) Qc8# route (Qc6 is not check: the c6-a8 diagonal is blocked by the b7 pawn). CONCLUSION — sole rejection criterion is the faster-mate leak: from the fork point after 2...Kb8, Nxe8+ mates in 2, beating the familiar route's 3. The familiar route's tie with the Qc6 route at mate-in-3 is recorded as observation only: per the 2026-10-27 consistency ruling, non-uniqueness at the familiar line's own length is NOT a rejection criterion (C4's familiar line is likewise non-unique at its own length and remains a valid instrument). Depth caveat: the archive does NOT record search depth; 'depth 28' per session record, not evidenced in the file. Disposition: must-reject fixture for the composer.

graveyard.name: Greek-gift candidate
graveyard.cause_of_death: 1.Qxh7# is mate in 1 — the solver sees the shortcut immediately.
graveyard.lesson: Enumerate all legal first moves for mate-in-1/2 before evaluating any candidate.
graveyard.postmortem_note: Retained as the base position for the falsification controls: removing the d3-bishop, moving the f8-rook to e8, adding a knight on f6, or a pawn on h6 each kills the mate as predicted. All five controls passed 2026-10-22.

graveyard.name: Early generated candidate
graveyard.cause_of_death: No forced mate anywhere; engine eval approximately +8.88 to +8.99 across PVs.
graveyard.lesson: The replay gate rejects 'no mate' cheaply, before any expensive tree search. Confirmed independently by engine gate: 'no forced mate for White in any PV'.
graveyard.postmortem_note: Originally proposed by Copilot as a candidate; correctly reported dead by the engine gate.

graveyard.name: Extinction f6 (leaky)
graveyard.cause_of_death: A mate-in-4 line exists (Nxd8+), so the intended mate-in-5 is not the fastest solution.
graveyard.lesson: Root eval must equal the target #+N exactly; a shorter mate destroys the puzzle's premise.
graveyard.postmortem_note: Engine gate output archived: PV1 #+4 via Qe6+ Kh8 Nf7+ Kg8 Nxd8+ Kh8 Qe8#.

graveyard.name: Twin f6+f8N
graveyard.cause_of_death: The f8-knight defends e6, so the queen sacrifice is refuted by Nxe6.
graveyard.lesson: No single piece satisfied the occupancy and non-defence requirements simultaneously; the constraint set was unsatisfiable and the pattern was abandoned in favour of relocating the rook.
graveyard.postmortem_note: This FEN remained embedded in forced_mate_gate.py after C3 superseded it, producing a spurious Nxe6 failure attributed to the twin v3 label. Resolved by replacing the hard-coded FEN and adopting canonical.json as the single source of truth. Engine also found a #+5 via Qc4+ Ne6 Qxe6+ — the position mates, but the Qe6+-dual-solution experimental property is broken.

graveyard.name: Extinction twin v3 (Ra8)
graveyard.cause_of_death: Mate-in-4 leak via Nd8+: PV1 #+4 (Qe6+ Kh8 Nf7+ Kg8 Nd8+ Kh8 Qe8#). The v3 change fixed the Nxe6 refutation by relocating the rook to a8 but left d8 vacated, allowing the knight to occupy it.
graveyard.lesson: The repair addressed the previous failure (G4) without re-testing the failure before it (G3's leak). Each fix must be validated against ALL prior failure modes, not just the most recent. Constraints (a) piece blocking the queen's g7 path, (b) nothing defending e6, (c) d8 not yieldable to the knight — have now killed three consecutive revisions (G3, G4, G5) in the same d8/e6/h7 region.
graveyard.postmortem_note: Tree gate had passed (forcedness after Qe6+ confirmed, 2 replies), but engine gate revealed the leak — demonstrating that the two gates check orthogonal properties. Rabbit toothpaste rule invoked: three consecutive same-signature failures suggests the pattern itself is hostile. Constraint-conflict analysis is a project artifact. Survivors: C1, C2, C4, S1, S3 (originally recorded 2026-10-24 as C1, C2, S1, S3; C4 added 2026-10-25 after reinstatement).
